title: Owner's own physical impact / hitchhiker effect
summary: Breaks Silence tells of Owner's own physical impact / hitchhiker effect, about last 2 years at Skinwalker Ranch, Utah, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: it's had a very real physical impact on people's lives, including mine.

plain: The owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange events, says on a podcast that whatever happens there has had a very real physical effect on people's lives, his own included. This is what some call the hitchhiker effect: the idea that something from the ranch follows people home. If true, it would mean the effects reach beyond the ranch itself.
